Description:
[list]

[*]Fully anonymized data collection
[*]No impact on game balance or progression

[*]This is a [b]non-commercial academic project[/b]

[list]
[*]🌱 The Farmer
[*]🛠️ The Artisan
[*]🎣 The Fisherman
[*]🐮 The Rancher
[*]🗣️ The Social Butterfly
[/list]
